_readme: Storyboard, checkpoint 2 of research/33-film-bible.md 7.1. Times are seconds from frame 0 at 30 fps. inFrame and outFrame are inclusive; frames is their count. A caption span enters at inSec and starts its exit at outSec, so a span followed immediately by another cross-fades into it and coverage never breaks. Captions live in captions[]; a shot points at one by index, so a caption is never torn down by a shot change. Capture paths are per pass: h is the 16:9 master, s the 1:1 cut, v the 9:16 cut. No shot in this set is a held still: every one has product motion, so every capture is a frame sequence. Written by Builder C. Nothing here is scaled, at any stage.
blurb: Accessibility, page speed, the links, the code that ran and the legal fine print, on the page you are standing on.
